name: Marble
benefits: Luxurious sheen, naturally cool underfoot, long lifespan
loss: Porous, stains easily with turmeric/acids, slippery when wet

name: Granite
benefits: Heat-proof, scratch-proof, highly durable
loss: Heavy structural deadweight, cold touch, reflects acoustic echo

name: Epoxy Flooring
benefits: Pet-claw proof, seamless, ultra-easy to sanitize
loss: Yellows over time under direct UV sunlight, scratch repair needs recoating

name: Teak Wood
benefits: Warm natural feel, excellent acoustic damping, timeless grain
loss: Scratches easily from pet claws, requires seasonal polishing, high cost

name: Engineered Wood
benefits: Warm, dimensionally stable in humid Mumbai weather, pre-finished
loss: Vulnerable to standing moisture, termite risk if untreated

name: Polished Concrete
benefits: Cost-effective, indestructible durability, industrial modern aesthetic
loss: Cold underfoot, prone to hairline micro-cracks over time

name: Vitrified Tiles
benefits: Affordable, non-porous stain proof, kid-spill proof
loss: Cold feel, grout lines can discolor without epoxy grout

name: Ceramic Tiles
benefits: Budget-friendly, high anti-skid textures available, huge design variety
loss: Brittle, can chip upon heavy impact, softer glaze than vitrified

name: Kota Stone
benefits: Very economical, tough, non-slip, impervious to heavy weather
loss: Matte greenish-grey look can appear dull, requires rough polishing

name: Laterite Stone
benefits: Naturally breathable, local Konkan material, rustic earthy texture
loss: Porous, requires water-repellent plaster or sealant against coastal rain

name: Terrazzo (Mosaic)
benefits: Artisanal custom aggregate chips, seamless, durable
loss: Labour intensive on-site grinding, slow cure time

name: Bamboo Flooring
benefits: Eco-friendly fast renewable resource, warm wood aesthetic
loss: Sensitive to high Mumbai monsoon humidity, can swell if not acclimated

name: Slate Stone
benefits: Rich textured cleft finish, fireproof, slip resistant
loss: Can flake along cleavage lines, difficult to mop clean

name: Travertine
benefits: Classic European pitted texture, sophisticated warm beige tones
loss: Porous holes require filling/honing, sensitive to acidic cleaners

name: Cork Flooring
benefits: Soft impact cushioning for elder joints, shock absorbing, thermal insulator
loss: Can indent under heavy point furniture, pet claws can gouge surface

name: Quartzite Countertops
benefits: Harder than granite, marble-like dramatic veining, scratch immune
loss: Expensive, heavy, requires diamond blades for precision cutting

name: Acoustic Wood Slats
benefits: Absorbs speech reverberation, NRC 0.85, modern scandinavian warmth
loss: Collects dust in grooves, wall surface application only

name: Exposed Red Wirecut Brick
benefits: Rustic warm industrial character, zero paint needed, thermal mass
loss: Needs periodic silicone sealer in coastal air to prevent damp efflorescence

name: Fluted Reeded Glass
benefits: Diffuses natural light beautifully while preserving visual privacy
loss: Fragile compared to solid walls, harder to clean ridges

name: Limewash / Venetian Plaster
benefits: Breathable, naturally anti-microbial & mold resistant, organic velvety texture
loss: Cannot scrub with harsh soaps, requires skilled artisan application

name: Clay Terracotta Tiles
benefits: Traditional earthy cool texture, 100% natural and sustainable
loss: Absorbs oil and stains readily, requires frequent sealing

name: Corian Solid Surface
benefits: Zero visible seams, non-porous, thermoformable into curves
loss: Scratches with knives, scorches under hot pans

name: Charcoal Wall Louvers
benefits: 100% waterproof and termite proof, striking deep fluted shadows
loss: Synthetic polystyrene material, static attracts fine lint

name: Seamless Microcement
benefits: Continuous 3mm layer over existing surfaces, completely waterproof, sleek
loss: Requires meticulous subfloor leveling, high artisan labour cost

name: Perforated Architectural Jali
benefits: Allows passive breeze ventilation while blocking harsh Mumbai afternoon glare
loss: Prone to coastal rust if not hot-dip galvanized and powder coated
